column2: The horse lifted one hoof so the farrier could check the iron shoe.
column3: 那匹馬抬起一隻蹄，讓蹄鐵匠檢查鐵掌。
column5: hoof 的兩個 o 像馬蹄的兩個圓印

column2: The robbers held a bank clerk hostage until police promised them a getaway car.
column3: 搶匪挾持一名銀行行員當人質，直到警方答應給他們一輛逃逸用車。
column4: take someone hostage (挾持某人為人質)
column5: host 主人 + age：被當成「客人」留在對方手上的人

column2: Rising rent has made decent housing hard to find for young workers in the city.
column3: 租金上漲讓都市裡的年輕上班族很難找到像樣的住房。
column5: house 房子 + ing：集合所有房子的總稱

column2: Without outside interference, the two teams settled the quarrel by themselves.
column3: 沒有外人干涉，兩隊自己解決了爭吵。
column5: inter 之間 + fere 打：有人插進你們之間亂打亂

column2: Each reader gave a different interpretation of the poem's last line.
column3: 每位讀者對這首詩的最後一行都有不同的詮釋。
column5: interpret 解釋 + ation：把不清楚的意思講明白

column2: An interpreter stood beside the mayor and repeated every sentence in Japanese.
column3: 一位口譯員站在市長旁邊，把每一句話都用日語重述一遍。
column5: interpret 翻譯 + er：幫雙方「接通」語言的人

column2: Ferries run twice a day from the harbor to the tiny isle off the coast.
column3: 渡輪每天從港口開兩班到近海的那座小島。
column5: isle 的 s 不發音，跟 aisle 走道、I'll 同音

column2: Green ivy crept up the brick wall until it covered the old window.
column3: 綠色的常春藤爬上磚牆，直到蓋住那扇舊窗戶。
column4: ivy climbs the wall (常春藤爬牆)
column5: ivy 諧音「愛威」：愛爬威風高牆的藤

column2: She wore a smooth jade bracelet that her grandmother had given her.
column3: 她戴著奶奶送給她的一只光滑玉鐲。
column5: jade 諧音「潔的」：潔白溫潤的寶石

column2: Fresh jasmine floating in the cup made the whole tea smell sweet.
column3: 杯中漂浮的新鮮茉莉讓整杯茶都散發甜香。
column5: jasmine 諧音「架死民」：架上開滿白花的茉莉

column2: She studied journalism at university because she wanted to report the truth.
column3: 她在大學主修新聞學，因為想要報導真相。
column5: journal 日報 + ism：與寫日報有關的行業

column2: The journalist interviewed the survivors and wrote a long article by midnight.
column3: 那位記者訪問了倖存者，並在午夜前寫出一篇長篇報導。
column5: journal 日報 + ist：每天寫新聞的人

column2: The lad from the next village helped carry our bags up the hill.
column3: 隔壁村的那個小伙子幫我們把袋子扛上山丘。
column5: lad 跟 lady 相對，lad 是男孩、lady 是女士

column2: Our landlady lives downstairs and bakes cookies for the tenants every Sunday.
column3: 我們的女房東住在樓下，每週日都烤餅乾給房客。
column4: a kind landlady (親切的女房東)
column5: land 土地 + lady 女士：擁有房子土地的女士

column2: The landlord promised to fix the leaking roof before the next rainy season.
column3: 房東答應在下個雨季前修好漏水的屋頂。
column4: pay the landlord (付房租給房東)
column5: land 土地 + lord 主人：土地的主人

column2: A sudden lash of rain stung our faces as we hurried across the bridge.
column3: 當我們匆忙走過橋時，一陣猛烈的雨打在臉上，刺痛我們。
column4: the lash of the wind (風的猛烈抽打)
column5: lash 諧音「辣屎」：像鞭子啪一下的猛打

column2: Cities at high latitude, such as Oslo, have very short days in winter.
column3: 高緯度的城市如奧斯陸，冬天的白晝非常短。
column5: lat 像 flat 平：緯度是橫著畫的平行線

column2: The lawmaker proposed a new rule to protect children from unsafe toys.
column3: 那位立法者提出一項新規定，以保護孩子免於不安全的玩具。
column5: law 法律 + maker 製造者：訂出法律的人

column2: The lieutenant gave the order, and the young soldiers marched out at dawn.
column3: 中尉下達命令，年輕的士兵們在黎明時列隊出發。
column5: 美式唸 lu-TEN-nant，lieu 是「代替」，替長官出力的人

column2: Cows, sheep, and other livestock graze on the open grassland all summer.
column3: 牛、羊和其他家畜整個夏天都在遼闊的草原上吃草。
column5: live 活 + stock 存貨：活著的存貨，就是家畜

column2: A swarm of locusts swept across the field and ate every green leaf.
column3: 一大群蝗蟲掠過田野，吃光每一片綠葉。
column4: a swarm of locusts (一群蝗蟲)
column5: locust 諧音「樂可死特」：蝗蟲過境，農作物慘了

column2: The bakery printed its logo on every paper bag to help customers remember it.
column3: 這家麵包店在每個紙袋上印了商標，幫助顧客記住它。
column5: logo 諧音「樂購」：看到商標就想買

column2: Taipei lies at about 121 degrees east longitude on the world map.
column3: 台北在世界地圖上大約位於東經一百二十一度。
column5: long 長 + i + tude：沿著地球縱向拉長的線

column2: A pink lotus bloomed in the pond, floating above the muddy water.
column3: 一朵粉紅蓮花在池塘中綻放，浮在混濁的水面上。
column5: lotus 諧音「蘿特絲」：池中一朵蘿特絲公主般的花

column2: Ferries carry tourists from the island to the mainland every hour.
column3: 渡輪每小時載遊客從島上到大陸。
column5: main 主要 + land 土地：主要的那一大塊陸地

column2: Her ideas were once strange, but now they are part of the mainstream.
column3: 她的想法曾經很奇特，但現在已成為主流的一部分。
column5: main 主要 + stream 河流：河中最大的那條水流

column2: Visitors stood silent before the majesty of the snow-covered mountains.
column3: 遊客在白雪覆蓋的群山雄偉氣勢前靜靜站著。
column4: the majesty of nature (大自然的壯麗)
column5: major 大 + ty：大到讓人肅然起敬的壯麗

column2: A stone mansion with forty rooms stands at the top of the hill.
column3: 一棟有四十個房間的石造大宅矗立在山頂。
column5: man 人 + sion：大人物住的大房子

column2: In October, the maple leaves along the road turn bright red and gold.
column3: 十月時，路旁的楓葉轉為鮮紅與金黃。
column5: maple 諧音「妹珀」：妹妹愛的楓糖漿來自它

column2: The marshal led the parade on horseback while the crowd waved flags.
column3: 典禮官騎著馬帶領遊行，群眾則揮舞旗幟。
column5: marshal 諧音「馬修」：騎馬帶隊的馬修指揮官

column2: Students in physics class study the mechanics of falling objects and moving cars.
column3: 物理課的學生研究落體與行駛中汽車的力學。
column5: mechanic 機械 + s：研究機械與力運作的學問

column2: In the fairy tale, the mermaid gave up her voice to walk on land.
column3: 在童話故事中，美人魚為了能在陸地行走而放棄了她的聲音。
column5: mer 古字「海」+ maid 少女：海裡的少女

column2: The old truck had a lot of mileage, so Dad sold it before it broke down.
column3: 那輛舊卡車的里程數很高，所以爸爸在它壞掉前就賣掉了。
column5: mile 英里 + age：跑了多少英里的累積

column2: She chewed a mint after lunch to make her breath smell fresh.
column3: 她午餐後嚼了一顆薄荷糖，讓口氣清新。
column5: mint 諧音「命特」：一口涼到命都特別清醒

column2: The miser counted his coins each night and refused to buy new shoes.
column3: 那個吝嗇鬼每天夜裡數他的銅板，卻不肯買新鞋。
column4: a stingy miser (小氣的守財奴)
column5: miser 諧音「Me 守」：只想「我守著」錢的人

column2: The mistress of the house greeted every guest at the door with a warm smile.
column3: 這屋子的女主人在門口以溫暖的微笑迎接每位客人。
column4: the mistress of the house (女主人)
column5: mister 先生的女性版，管家的 mistress 就是女主人

column2: Airplane mode turns off the phone's signal, so you can use it during a flight.
column3: 飛航模式會關掉手機的訊號，所以你在飛行途中也能使用。
column4: switch to silent mode (切換成靜音模式)
column5: mode 諧音「磨的」：每種磨法，就是一種模式

column2: The monarch ruled for fifty years and was loved by the common people.
column3: 那位君主統治了五十年，深受平民愛戴。
column5: mon 單獨 + arch 統治：獨自一人統治國家

column2: Many writers have praised motherhood in poems about love and sacrifice.
column3: 許多作家在關於愛與犧牲的詩中讚美母性。
column4: the joys of motherhood (為人母的喜悅)
column5: mother 母親 + hood 狀態：當媽媽這種狀態

column2: Dad pushed the mower back and forth until the whole lawn looked even.
column3: 爸爸來回推著割草機，直到整片草坪看起來平整。
column5: mow 割 + er：割草的機器，讀音像「摸兒」草
